[[Tenebrous Crystal]]s are [[crafting material]]s used to craft new tiers of guild [[Tenebrous weapons]] and armor.

== Notes ==
* The Ore Synthesizer has a rare chance to grant 10 Crystals per harvest.
* You will need 160 Tenebrous Crystals to unlock the skins for all of the weapons.
* You will need a total of 66 Tenebrous Crystals or [[Shimmering Crystal|Shimmering Crystals]] to unlock all the guild armor skins.
{{anomaly|Players who do not have the Heart of Thorns expansion may still receive Tenebrous Crystals from the synthesizer.}}

== Trivia ==
* Tenebrous means dark; shadowy, gloomy or obscure. It's the opposite of "Shimmering".
* Prior to being added to [[Gharr Leadclaw]]'s exchange, they were one of the two unique materials that could only be obtained in [[guild hall]]s.
